confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate with no live listing checks. Egyptian pound volatility over 2024-2026 makes USD prices uncertain, and hotel anchors are the least certain, especially whether quoted rates include taxes and fees. Cocktail and wine_glass were set from the local beer relationship (roughly 2x beer) because direct knowledge is weak. The FX observation came from search-result summaries that cite the RBA exchange-rates pages; the underlying RBA table was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was copied. Anchors reflect general knowledge of Cairo's tourist price tiers, set against budget-to-mid-range Middle East and North African tourist cities. Restaurant anchors assume local-currency pricing with a tourist premium. Accommodation anchors assume tax- and fee-inclusive nightly rates in central tourist districts (Downtown, Zamalek, Heliopolis) for July 2026.
